# docker_builder_prune (Action)

Removes build cache, like `docker builder prune`, and reports the cache records removed and the space reclaimed. Without `builder` it prunes the Engine's own build cache (`POST /build/prune`); with `builder` it prunes that buildx builder's cache, like `docker buildx prune --builder`. Unlike destroying a `docker_buildx_builder`, it never removes a builder.

Actions require Terraform 1.14 or later. An action keeps no state: it runs when
a resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [...] actions = [action.docker_builder_prune.<name>] } }`
fires, or on demand with `terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_builder_prune.<name>`.
Arguments go in the action's `config` block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Prunes a buildx builder's cache instead of the daemon's (set builder to its name).
action "docker_builder_prune" "buildx" {
  config {
    builder = "ci"
    all     = true
  }
}

resource "docker_image" "app" {
  name = "app:dev"

  build {
    context = "${path.module}/app"
  }

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_builder_prune.old]
    }
  }
}

# Removes build cache older than a week from the daemon's own BuildKit after each build. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_builder_prune.old
action "docker_builder_prune" "old" {
  config {
    filters = { until = "168h" }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all` (Boolean) Remove all build cache, not only unused (dangling) records (`--all`). Default `false`.
- `builder` (String) Name of a buildx builder whose cache to prune. Unset: the daemon's own build cache (BuildKit inside dockerd).
- `filters` (Map of String) Build cache filters, one value per key, e.g. `until` (`24h`), `id`, `parent`, `type`, `description`, `inuse`, `shared` or `private`. With `builder`, `until` and `unused-for` take a Go duration (`24h`, `90m`) and other keys match exactly (`key==value`), or as a substring when the value starts with `~` (`key~=value`).
- `keep_storage` (Number) Bytes of cache to keep (`--keep-storage`, deprecated by BuildKit). Only with `builder`; the Engine endpoint takes `reserved_space` instead.
- `max_used_space` (Number) Remove cache until at most this many bytes are used (`--max-used-space`). Needs Engine API >= 1.48.
- `min_free_space` (Number) Remove cache until this many bytes of disk are free (`--min-free-space`). Needs Engine API >= 1.48.
- `reserved_space` (Number) Bytes of cache to keep at least (`--reserved-space`). Needs Engine API >= 1.48.
- `result_path` (String) Local file the action writes its result object to after a successful run. The file holds one JSON object keyed by the action's output names (`result`, the identity values, the raw outputs with their `*_sha256` hashes, and the version values), with keys sorted at every level, two-space indentation and a trailing newline; it is written atomically (temporary file, then rename) and parent directories are created. Read it in a later run with `jsondecode(file(...))` or the `local_file` data source. Sensitive values are written in full, since this is your own file, but show as `(sensitive)` in the progress message. Nothing is written when the action fails.
